faq.q: What routing algorithms does Trackeys use?
faq.a: A hybrid of metaheuristic solvers (genetic + simulated annealing) for large-scale batch optimization, and real-time constraint satisfaction for dynamic re-routing. The engine considers up to 20 factors simultaneously including delivery windows, vehicle constraints, driver shifts and traffic.

GPS updates stream every 30 seconds by default, configurable down to 10 seconds for high-priority operations. Accuracy is typically 10–50 meters depending on signal conditions. End-to-end latency from device to dispatch map is under 5 seconds.
Yes. Manifests, navigation, POD capture and payment collection all function without signal. Everything syncs when connectivity returns — no lost drops, no re-entry.

faq.q: Does it handle cold chain / temperature monitoring?
faq.a: Yes, via integration with IoT temperature sensors. Breach alerts fire in real time; full temperature logs attach to every delivery for compliance and dispute resolution.
